thread.title: Supreme Court seems open to letting Apple antitrust suit proceed - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Jason Aycock
title: Supreme Court seems open to letting Apple antitrust suit proceed - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
The Supreme Court has finished arguments in an appeal by Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) of an App Store antitrust case, and the justices appear to observers to be inclined to let the suit proceed .
Shares have turned negative on the day, now down 0.4% .
Apple had asked to overturn a lower court ruling reviving a class action suit that charged the company with violating antitrust laws via its App Store, requiring apps to be sold through the store and taking its 30% commission.
Plaintiffs are seeking monetary damages and say Apple's monopoly leads to inflated prices vs. an alternative where the apps were available through other sources.
Apple (backed by the Trump administration and the Chamber of Commerce) argues that a loss here would threaten the field of e-commerce.
